answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before it can trade. A nebula of cheap fake accounts collapses because each fake must fund its own stake, so creating thousands costs real capital. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest from fees, while a whisper of fraud triggers slashing that burns the attacker's deposit. A gale of sybils still arrives, but it pays full price for every identity and loses money on each one it burns.
